display_name: Higher Education Research and Development Survey
publisher: National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics, U.S. National Science Foundation
license_and_reuse: NCSES public-use file. Exact redistribution terms for repackaged downloads were not resolved in this pass; retain source links and treat redistribution as conditional.
grain: institution reporting entity by fiscal year by questionnaire number, row, and column
universe: higher education institutions reporting separately accounted research and development expenditures under HERD survey rules
boundary_notes: University of Delaware maps exactly to UNITID 130943 and NCSES ID U3284001 in FY2024. Four institutions in its DFR comparison group have HERD rows with blank UNITID and broader or differently named reporting boundaries.
reporting_period_definition: Fiscal year 2024 as defined in the FY2024 HERD survey and file documentation.
typical_lag: published after survey collection and NCSES review; use release date recorded with each file
revision_policy: NCSES may issue corrections and errata; store file hash and release retrieval date and retain prior vintages
join_path: ipeds_unitid 130943 plus ncses_inst_id U3284001 to institution_key UD_CORE and boundary_id CORE
suppression_rules: Retain the source status field. Do not infer values for suppressed cells.
